description.p: Rofi Hub is a small launcher that presents the installed Rofi apps in one keyboard-driven menu. It remembers the selected theme and starts the chosen app directly.

ul.li: Calendar: a month sheet with date search.
Keyboard Shortcuts: a Hyprland binding reference that can run exec bindings.
Clipboard History: a cliphist picker that copies the selected entry again.
Screen Time: local daily app timelines and totals for Hyprland sessions.

description.p: First multi-app release with calendar, keybinds, and clipboard providers.
